summary: United States Natural Gas Fund, LP filed a Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with Société Générale, originally dated June 13, 2022. The amendment, effective October 13, 2026, lowers the Total Net Assets Decline Event Additional Termination Event threshold from $1.5 billion to $200 million. The reduced TNA threshold reflects the registrant's performance and aims to ensure the ATE is not triggered absent a credit event. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine derivative agreement amendment, not a special situation.
